frosty_fields_bg: deep winter: thick soft snow on every roof, ledge and the ground base, icicles hanging from eaves, frosted pale-blue stone, dark pine-green and warm red accents, a warm glowing window or lantern
golden_meadow_bg: high-summer golden meadow: warm honey-coloured timber, golden thatch, tall golden grass tufts and small yellow wildflowers at the base, amber and cream tones
misty_morning_bg: calm misty lakeland: weathered silver-grey birch wood, sage-green moss on stones and roofs, small lavender bushes at the base, soft silver-teal palette
bg_aurora_skies: northern tundra: dark spruce timber and slate, patches of old snow, teal moss, small glowing ice-blue crystals and rune-carved stones as accents, teal and violet palette
spring_bloom_bg: Dutch spring: crisp white-painted trim, red brick, neat green paint, small pots and clusters of red, yellow and purple tulips at the base, fresh bright palette. Keep the mine's stonework RED BRICK on every level (never white stone)
blossom_festival_bg: Japanese blossom festival: dark wood with vermilion-red lacquered beams, curved tiled roof edges, pink cherry petals on roofs and ground, small round red-and-cream paper lanterns
verdant_valley_bg: lush jungle: mossy stone, thick green vines and big tropical leaves growing over it, a few bright tropical flowers, deep emerald and jade palette
honey_hollow_bg: honey farm: warm golden wood, hexagonal honeycomb tile details, small straw skep beehive or honey pot accents, clover and sunflowers at the base, honey-gold palette
sunny_shores_bg: tropical beach: sun-bleached driftwood and bamboo, palm-thatch roofs, sand at the base, seashells, rope and a small striped awning, turquoise and coral accents
harvest_fair_bg: autumn county fair: red-and-white striped canvas accents, colourful triangular bunting, orange autumn leaves, small pumpkins and hay bales at the base, ochre and barn-red palette
golden_grove_bg: autumn apple orchard: warm oak timber, golden fallen leaves on roofs and base, red apples in small baskets or barrels, amber and apple-red palette
pumpkin_moon_bg: autumn pumpkin night-dawn: dark weathered wood, orange leaves, small carved jack-o-lanterns glowing softly, corn stooks, plum-violet and pumpkin-orange palette
oktoberfest_festival_meadow_bg: Bavarian Oktoberfest: white walls with dark timber framing, blue-and-white diamond pattern accents and small pennants, flower boxes, a small pretzel or beer barrel accent. Trees keep green summer leaves (never white, never snowy)
halloween_haunted_hollow_bg: friendly-spooky Halloween (cute, not scary): crooked dark-grey wood and stone, purple slate, cobwebs at corners, small glowing pumpkins, slate-grey, purple and orange-glow palette
halloween_candy_lane_bg: sweet candy land: gingerbread and pastel candy materials, white icing drips on roofs, candy-cane posts, gumdrops and lollipops at the base, pink, mint and cream palette
